Pain management · West Chester, PA

Specialized pain, migraine & injection care in West Chester.

Located in Westtown Business Center near Routes 3 and 352, our small office provides individualized care for pain, migraines, and related conditions. Your treatment plan reflects your specific needs.

What we offer

Care matched to your needs

Chronic pain management services may be considered after an individual evaluation. Your clinician will discuss the options that fit your situation.

01 / PROCEDURES

Pain procedures

Cervical, thoracic and lumbar epidural injections; nerve root, facet, medial branch and sacroiliac joint blocks; radiofrequency ablation (RFA); trigger point and cortisone injections.

02 / HEADACHE CARE

Migraine treatment

Botox for chronic migraine and medications such as Aimovig, Ajovy, Emgality, Vyepti, Nurtec and Ubrelvy.

03 / JOINT CARE

Knee injections

Hip, knee and shoulder joint injections, including knee treatments such as Synvisc, Orthovisc and Monovisc.

04 / MEDICATIONS

Medication management

Medication management, low-dose naltrexone and, when appropriate after evaluation, chronic opioid therapy. The clinic also lists urine drug screening.

05 / ADDICTION CARE

Suboxone & Sublocade

Suboxone therapy, including treatment for opioid addiction, and Sublocade injections.

06 / ADDITIONAL CARE

Other services

Medication-assisted weight loss for obesity, with medications such as phentermine, Wegovy and Zepbound; testosterone replacement therapy; and Spravato for depression.

The clinic also lists spinal cord stimulators. Treatment availability and eligibility are determined by the clinic. Call to discuss a specific service.

About the practice

Meet Dr. Garg

Dr. Garg is board certified in Pain Management, Anesthesiology, and Internal Medicine. He trained in Internal Medicine at UMDNJ and completed Anesthesiology and Pain Management training at the University of Rochester in New York.

Dr. Garg combines conventional and complementary approaches, including injections, medications, physical therapy, behavioral therapy, massage, chiropractic care and acupuncture. Treatment plans are individualized.

Dr. Pankaj Garg treats chronic back and neck pain, joint pain, migraines, diabetic neuropathy, fibromyalgia, and complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS/RSD). Care focuses on evaluating possible causes, managing symptoms, and improving daily function.El Dr. Pankaj Garg atiende dolor crónico de espalda y cuello, dolor articular, migrañas, neuropatía diabética, fibromialgia y síndrome de dolor regional complejo (SDRC). What treatment options are available for chronic back and neck pain?¿Qué tratamientos existen para el dolor crónico de espalda y cuello?

Depending on the cause, treatment may include medication management, cervical or lumbar epidural injections, and radiofrequency ablation (RFA). Dr. Garg reviews your symptoms and medical history before recommending an option.Según la causa, el tratamiento puede incluir manejo de medicamentos, inyecciones epidurales cervicales o lumbares y ablación por radiofrecuencia (RFA). El Dr. Garg revisa los síntomas y antecedentes antes de recomendar una opción. Read on FAQ page →Ver en preguntas frecuentes →

What is radiofrequency ablation (RFA), and how long can pain relief last?¿Qué es la ablación por radiofrecuencia (RFA) y cuánto dura el alivio?

Radiofrequency ablation uses heat to interrupt pain signals from selected nerves. For some people, relief lasts about 6–12 months, but the effect and duration vary. An evaluation determines if the procedure is appropriate.La ablación por radiofrecuencia utiliza calor para interrumpir señales de dolor de ciertos nervios. En algunas personas, el alivio dura aproximadamente de 6 a 12 meses, aunque varía. Se necesita una evaluación para determinar si es apropiada. Read on FAQ page →Ver en preguntas frecuentes →

Are pain management procedures painful, and what are the possible risks and recovery times?¿Duelen los procedimientos y cuáles son los riesgos y tiempos de recuperación?

You may feel discomfort during or after an injection, and local anesthetic can help. Possible risks include soreness, bruising, bleeding, infection, and rare nerve injury. Recovery and driving restrictions depend on the procedure. Ask the clinician about your specific risks and instructions.Puede haber molestias durante o después de una inyección; la anestesia local puede ayudar. Los riesgos incluyen dolor local, hematomas, sangrado, infección y, en raras ocasiones, lesión nerviosa. La recuperación y las restricciones para conducir dependen del procedimiento. Consulte sus riesgos e instrucciones particulares. Read on FAQ page →Ver en preguntas frecuentes →
